checks.description: 256-D L2-normalized z_eeg
Availability flag present; zero vector when EEG absent
Multi-condition: AD, PD and MS all represented
Three independent risk scores emitted per subject
Risk scores are independent sigmoids, not a competing softmax
Per-condition risk AUC reported with bootstrap confidence intervals
0.5-40 Hz band-pass preserving five named bands
5th-order Butterworth filter applied
Automated FastICA with three documented rejection criteria
4 s epochs, 50% overlap, 150 uV rejection, >=20 clean epochs
Hybrid STFT + Morlet CWT multi-resolution tensor implemented
Three encoder architectures implemented and ablated
Shared head: Linear -> BatchNorm -> ReLU -> L2
Electrode dropout, Gaussian noise and temporal jitter augmentation
Stratified 5-fold CV with subject-level grouping
Binary neurological-vs-control AUC >= 0.8
F1 and precision-recall reported
Silhouette coefficient and inter-class Euclidean distance reported
Robustness at dropout 5/10/20% and SNR 20/10/5 dB
Graceful-degradation contract verified (zero vector + flag 0)
checks.detail: degradation percentage requires the group fusion engine — scoped, not claimed
